Create a generic OpenLineage facet

Source: R/ol-facets.R
ol_facet.Rd

Creates a facet for extensions or facet schemas without a typed constructor. Names supplied through ... are preserved exactly at the JSON boundary.

Usage

ol_facet(..., schema_url, producer = OPENLINEAGE_PRODUCER, deleted = NULL)

Arguments

...

Named facet fields using their OpenLineage wire names, and the schema URL as the one unnamed argument when schema_url is not named.

schema_url

The URI of the facet's JSON Schema definition.

producer

A URI identifying the facet producer.

deleted

Whether this facet deletes a previously emitted job or dataset facet. Use only where the target schema supports _deleted.

Value

A generic OpenLineage facet accepted in any facet map.

Details

The schema URL is either named schema_url or given as the one unnamed argument, usually the first. schema_url, producer and deleted come after ..., so they are matched only by their full names: a field such as schema or prod is a field, never a partial match for an argument.

Field values map to JSON as follows:

  • A length-1 vector is a JSON scalar. Wrap it in I() (I("only")) or a list() to write a one-element array. Longer vectors are arrays.

  • A named list is an object and an unnamed list is an array. An empty unnamed list() is []; use setNames(list(), character()) for {}.

  • NULL fields are omitted, so a JSON null cannot be written.

  • Integer-valued numbers up to 2^53 are written exactly; other numbers with the fewest digits that read back as the same double.

  • A POSIXct value is written as an event time (new_event_time()), a Date as YYYY-MM-DD and a factor as its labels.

  • Missing values, NaN, infinite numbers, complex and raw vectors, named atomic vectors, lists with repeated or empty names, text that is not valid UTF-8 and other classed objects raise an openlineage_validation_error when the facet is serialized.

Examples

facet <- ol_facet(
  "https://example.com/CustomRunFacet.json",
  customValue = "example",
  tags = I("nightly")
)
Run(new_run_id(), facets = list(custom = facet))
#> <openlineage::Run>
#>  @ run_id: chr "ce229ca4-6610-48d6-93ae-14b614ce8a41"
#>  @ facets: List of 1
#>  .. $ custom: <openlineage::GenericFacet>
#>  ..  ..@ producer  : chr "https://github.com/pedrobtz/openlineage"
#>  ..  ..@ schema_url: chr "https://example.com/CustomRunFacet.json"
#>  ..  ..@ deleted   : NULL
#>  ..  ..@ fields    : List of 2
#>  .. .. .. $ customValue: chr "example"
#>  .. .. .. $ tags       : 'AsIs' chr "nightly"
